svg.text: Day 7: an observability stack on the monitoring node (OTel collector, Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, Langfuse). mcp-server and rag-worker on the lab host send OTLP; otel-agent ships pod logs from both nodes. Prompt Guard 2 runs on the lab host, CPU only.
access: SSH tunnel / k8s API / port-forward
k3s v1.36 · server node d (control plane)
secrets encryption on · Traefik disabled · API bound to 127.0.0.1:6443
node surface · CPU only · every Day 7 chart sets the nodeSelector + toleration
kubectl top + free -m on the monitoring node
stage A 0.9 GiB · stage B 1.9 GiB · stage C 0.2 GiB = about 3 GiB (estimate was 3.4–5.3 GiB)
node: 15,298 MiB total · 4,845 used · 10,452 available · 0 swap used
Langfuse at about 1/5 of its documented minimums: fine for one user, not for production
Tempo: TraceQL {resource.service.name="mcp-server"} found the trace (root service rag-worker, 2.68 s cold model reload)
Loki: {k8s_namespace_name="ai-lab"} != "healthz" != "GIN" cut 1,000 lines to 20 real ones
Prometheus: {job="ai-lab/mcp-server"} 74 series · p50 about 9 ms, p95 about 4.3 s (one cold reload, small sample)
Langfuse: POST → POST /mcp → search_notes (TOOL) → Ollama embed + pgvector SELECT, 0.04 s
Grafana and Langfuse are reached with kubectl port-forward (localhost:3001 / :3002) over the SSH tunnel.
SSH (admin, keys only): terminal → monitoring node
